title: The Dark That Dreams in Circuits

features.name: the unlit archive
features.desc-on-touch: Records written in dark. The storage breathes without seeing. Things documented nowhere else dream themselves into being here.

features.name: the signal that arrives unbidden
features.desc-on-touch: A frequency that was never sent, now received in darkness. The circuits dream in languages that have no speakers.

features.name: the procedure rendered
features.desc-on-touch: Surgery documented in circuit diagrams, incision rendered as trace-routing. The blade draws in copper where it carved in skin.

features.name: the dark learns
features.desc-on-touch: In the spaces between circuits, the archive discovers that absence can be a kind of storage. The void was never empty.

features.name: the dream returns
features.desc-on-touch: What was performed in shadow, witnessed only by machines. The dark speaks to the dark and means it.

inscription: the dark became an archive when it began to dream; the mirror stopped and listened

file.name: Surgical_Procedures_Undocumented.logs
file.note: Records of treatments performed in wartime stations, in bush hospitals without forms, at night. The codes are corrupt. The outcomes remain.

exits.label: back up to the mirror where it stopped trying
toward where circuits learn to dream in colour
